nd renew-vs-API cost advice.
﻿dsh-opencode-go-eta
A quota forecast widget for OpenCode Go inside DeepSeek Harness — it tells you when the monthly allo
wance runs out, and whether that happens before the renewal date.
English · 简体中文
Dark theme
Composer dock
The shipped context ring (54%) and the Go capsule (18%) share the same 14 px / 2 px specification; t
he capsule stays a text-only trigger, expanding nothing until clicked.
## Why
OpenCode Go is a flat monthly subscription, but its console only shows *used percentages* and a rese

t time.
It does not tell you whether your current pace will exhaust the allowance before the renewal

date — the one
question that decides whether you need to top up, renew early, or switch to the pay-

as-you-go API for the rest
of the period.
This plugin keeps a small local history of the official quota readings and answers that question in

the
composer dock. It never reads your session logs: the Go allowance is account-wide, so only the o

fficial
percentage sees usage from every client.
## Features
- **Projected exhaustion time** — a reset-aware Theil–Sen fit over the recorded quota samples gives

an ETA per window, with a confidence tier. No guessing from a single reading.
- **Renewal-date compa
rison** — says plainly whether the monthly allowance will run out *before* the renewal date, or leav

e headroom until then.
- **Long-run cost advice** — when the quota will run out early, it compares t
wo steady-state policies: renewing OpenCode Go (a prepayment of the next period, unit cost `planPric
e ÷ allowance` per $1 of usage, about $0.125) versus paying the overflow on the official API ($1 per

$1). Renewal is recommended unless the new allowance would largely expire unused.
- **Merged usage
& forecast chart** — history, projection, “now”, ETA and renewal markers on one time axis, with a 0–

100 % axis.
- **Native composer dock capsule** — the 14 px / 2 px ring matches the shipped context m
eter, so both rings read as peers; the card itself is a liquid-glass panel that dims its highlight l

ayers in dark mode.
- **Per-model allowance** — Go's monthly limit is *per model* (DeepSeek V4.1 Fla
sh: $80 on Go, $160 on Go Plus; Kimi K3: $15). The card shows the model and its allowance, while per

centages stay authoritative from the console.
- **No polling storms** — samples at four local anchor
s a day, on task ends, on start-up and on demand.
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (Desktop or Web profile) and Node.js ≥ 22.

> The plugin row is a bundle patch: `dsh plugin add` appends `dsh-opencode-go-eta` to
> `dsh.profile
.bundles` automatically, and the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.
## Configuration
Add to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` to override the defaults:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The API key is resolved through the Harness credentials service (`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`);
it never re

olved through the Harness credentials service (`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`);
it never reaches the browser.
## How it works
| Stage | Behaviour |
| Sampling | `GET /zen/go/v1/usage` (percentages + resets) and `GET /console/api/go/status` (meters,

period start/end) — at 03/09/15/21 local, on `turn/end`, at start-up, and on demand. |
| History |

Samples are kept for 45 days in `$DSH_HOME/opencode-go-eta/samples.json` (atomic writes). |
| Projec
tion | Samples from before the last reset are cut; the Theil–Sen slope of the current cycle gives th

e ETA. Fewer than 3 points or a span under 6 h is reported as *insufficient samples*. |
| Verdict |
ETA is compared with the window reset and the subscription's `endsAt`: *before expiry*, *after expir

y*, *safe within the cycle*. |
| Advice | Two steady-state policies: **renew** prices every $1 of us
age at `planPriceUsd ÷ allowance` (≈ $0.125), **API overflow** costs $1 per $1 on top of the plan. C
osts are annualised: at $96/month of usage the allowance lasts about 25 days, so renewal means ~14 p
eriods/year (≈$144) while the API path costs ≈$312/year. Renewal wins whenever usage exceeds one all
owance; the API only wins when the new allowance would expire unused. Official model prices come fro
m models.dev (12 h cache) for display only. At $96/month of usage the allowance lasts about 25 days,
so renewal means ~14 periods/year (≈$144) while the API path costs ≈$312/year. |
The console meter is a plan-credit cap (observed $60), while the official Go table lists a per-model
monthly allowance (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: $80). Percentages always follow the console; money follows

the
model allowance so the two never contradict each other silently.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

No network or real key is needed. `preview.html` reproduces the shipped styles with mock data
(`#sho
t` hides the page chrome; `#shot-dark` renders the dark theme).
## Limitations
- `/console/api/go/status` is an internal console endpoint; if it changes, the card falls back to pe

rcentages only.
- Projections are linear extrapolations from your own sampling history, not vendor f

orecasts.
- Cost advice assumes the quota-meter value and the official list price share the same sca

le; the token estimate is an approximation.
- The plugin stores no prompts or session data — only qu
ota readings and the pricing cache.
